intent: Draft the docs pack, AI gateway contract, agent-history contract and Obsidian sync script for the P3MD social integration repo.
summary: Drafted the gateway (README_AI_AGENT.md, contract v1.0 with rules C-01 to C-18), frontend and backend architecture, focused docs for RBAC (users, groups, roles, permissions), PWA notifications and Google Drive/Calendar integration, the phased task list (69 tasks), the agent-history JSON contract with schema, the Obsidian integration guide and generator script, and the graphify pack. Mid-session the scope grew to include group-based RBAC, a notification-first PWA and Google Workspace integration; the task list and migration order (M1-M9) were renumbered before anything was committed. The sync script was exercised in a sandbox; the SQL and application code in the docs are unexecuted drafts. Nothing is committed to a repository yet, so PSI-003 is not done.

changes.note: PWA shell, Web Push, notification center; M2
Drive documents and Calendar sync; M6

decisions.decision: Docs live in docs/; README.md and README_AI_AGENT.md stay at the repo root
decisions.reason: The template already has a docs/ folder and the root stays readable; the gateway links every doc
alternatives: Every file at the repo root

decisions.decision: Keep graphify-out/ at the root as engine output; docs/graphify-architecture/ holds curated exports and dated snapshots
decisions.reason: graphify's hooks and CLAUDE.md integration expect graphify-out/

decisions.decision: One JSON file per agent session in agent-history/entries/
decisions.reason: Parallel branches and agents never conflict

decisions.decision: Obsidian sync is one-way from the task list and history into obsidian-out/
decisions.reason: Avoids a second writer to the task list and merge conflicts with agent branches
alternatives: Two-way sync with the Kanban plugin as an editor

decisions.decision: Effective roles = direct roles plus roles inherited through groups; RLS reads membership tables, JWT claims only drive the UI
decisions.reason: Revoking a role, group membership or suspending a user takes effect on the next request
alternatives: RLS on JWT claims (up to one token lifetime of staleness)

decisions.decision: Google integration through one service account; Drive metadata mirrored and files streamed after an RLS check
decisions.reason: No per-user OAuth tokens or Google app verification; our RBAC decides who sees each document
alternatives: Drive /preview iframes that bypass our RBAC

decisions.decision: PWA scoped to install, Web Push and a notification center start page; no offline data
decisions.reason: Covers the mobile need with little service-worker complexity and keeps email volume low

verification.manual: Typecheck covers scripts/obsidian-sync.ts only (tsc --strict, bundler resolution). Ran the script under Node 22 type stripping with ajv 8 against these docs: --check passed on 69 tasks and this entry, sync generated the board, home, agent log, 69 task notes and 1 session note, a second run wrote 0 files, and a deliberately broken entry made --check exit 1. No repository, migrations or app code exist yet.

risks: SQL and TypeScript in the docs are unexecuted drafts; the first migration and feature tasks will surface errors
Third-party details flagged for verification: Resend batch cap and webhook payload, Supabase before-user-created hook payload and OAuth server method names, MCP CIMD support
The sync script type-checks under bundler resolution (Next.js default) but not under nodenext because of ajv's CommonJS default exports
